integrity: The formula is established by a six-way, mutually exclusive fiber case split. No independent assessment is claimed. The full body of the September 2026 motivating preprint could not be read through available public access routes; an unadvertised equivalent remains a historical novelty risk.
scientific_limitations: The exact bivariate formula concerns the full inverse-face-continuous partial-map monoid of stars, not arbitrary trees, forward graph homomorphisms, or the strict submonoid. Finite verification through five leaves corroborates but does not prove the infinite statement.
title: Domain-rank enumerator of graph-continuous partial maps on stars
